# Who is Jason Zhu, and what does GoSail Club do?

**Jason Zhu (祝彦森) is a former AI algorithm engineer turned AI entrepreneur, content creator, and marketing operator.** He has built a personal brand around AI tools, independent software businesses, and helping AI products reach international markets.

His business ecosystem has two related but distinct components: **GoSail Club**, which appears to be his learning and community offering, and **GoSail Lab**, which handles AI product marketing and influencer campaigns.

Here's what I found.

## 1\. Who is Jason Zhu?

![万象AI实验室首页](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/EDnlWJIr4SNO318k9-s-KcHq9uJ9mowmw1Brc6qDg3dO770UgELNI_NprtPRkHO90VhBwFo1RteXN5X6qY3JBn0PjQTlpdblqqF58s-4h76H8mbFMucOL7I9R6SG9xJciavn6Rg64qHfm0L6H02gGepSa-VRmu2Q7UaVHOXDUntU3yVcRltX22cmd38GIvtX?purpose=fullsize)

**Jason Zhu (祝彦森)**

- Former AI algorithm engineer.
- Now an AI blogger and entrepreneur.
- Creates content about AI tools, agents, and software development.
- Provides enterprise AI training and consulting.
- Operates under the X/Twitter handle **\@GoSailGlobal**\.

According to his [official website](https://jasonzhu.ai/), his work focuses on three areas\:

- **AI applications\:** Practical tutorials covering Claude Code, Cursor, AI agents, and other tools.
- **Independent entrepreneurship\:** Helping developers build and take software products overseas.
- **Creator monetization\:** Building an audience and turning content into business opportunities.

His website describes him as someone who moved from AI engineering into full-time AI content creation, enterprise training, and consulting. 【turn652016search0】【turn652016search1】【turn652016search2】

## 2\. What exactly is GoSail Club?

(Official membership community)

![Jason Zhu (@GoSailGlobal) on X](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/TiHwyfL4Rx64ooPhKv_zdbGMRrnWDWbT5xos0NgCYt37z5jELT82ZOoZh2a3lyNX5FRJXrTwOjfYxvoc4hOOQozkYeSMFviz9AS398D5C0LL7MTqVuKDinu0dKv2JjIikLj6wGxhZISMfYDf4r98laPivKWYm99rDImdq_ajWmwwIrtwTllAT7cot03PIFJW?purpose=fullsize)

[GoSail Club](https://jasonzhu.ai/zh/club) \(启航会) is a paid membership community focused on **AI-powered entrepreneurship, audience growth, and overseas business development**\.

It targets two main audiences\:

1. **Creators and independent founders** who want to grow on X (Twitter), build a personal brand, and monetize their audience.
2. **FDEs and AI technical consultants** who want to use AI agents and reusable skills to deliver projects faster.

### What members get

According to its membership page\:

- **AI tools and automation\:** AgentSkillsHub Pro, AI skills, and workflow tools.
- **Social media growth\:** Tools for identifying X trends, generating posts, and distributing content across X, Xiaohongshu, and WeChat public accounts.
- **Learning resources\:** A 105-page overseas business and creator-growth playbook.
- **Private community\:** Member-only group discussions and twice-monthly closed-door sessions.
- **Business opportunities\:** A pathway for creators to join GoSail Lab's influencer marketing network.

### Membership pricing

The published pricing is\:

**启航版 (Starter)**

# ¥365/year

Renewal: ¥99/year

Suitable for creators, developers, and technical consultants.

- AI tools and Skills
- Content distribution automation
- X growth tools
- Private community
- MCN collaboration pathway

---

**进阶版 (Advanced)**

# ¥2,999/year

Limited to 50 members; application required

Includes Starter benefits plus\:

- VIP private group
- Structured business and resource introductions
- Quarterly private online meetings
- Peer networking with established founders

Source: [Official GoSail Club membership page](https://jasonzhu.ai/zh/club)\. Pricing and benefits are those displayed on the page when researched.

## 3\. GoSail Club vs. GoSail Lab: What's the difference?

This is an important distinction.

![案例研究 | GoSail Lab](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/-AH38j72p03Nzqd9QPLMTxg0HRSDHqJq_NrM6hTxY9OV8yipvMZcI_-QYLnjoioqK9qSJvqQYWuBpgtUS900p8f-tu3bKHUdX1G0fReHjDvFywnlsiWEEwXLb_Rj8YEI49DuskNO7hhfuY9NXTl5RJfCjYg2sPV0-zq4FlIlCw5FWQ2dCf3Au81I3dEjZsoJ?purpose=fullsize)

**GoSail Club**

**Business model\:** Membership and education.

Its customers are individuals who want to learn, network, automate workflows, and develop businesses using AI.

[Membership website](https://jasonzhu.ai/zh/club)

---

![GoSail · 出海指南](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/oH7hJx9mAbpseuUMIPgcoNl079tgkxAd1AX0EsAG-8Tfof-l6ZknZFGu5uLc-3qgMThznWtOZ7A5QUWPmiBH8AyanAztVN9P2JFvMcIfXu_5N_ZJEFP02-3TWeLQNUO2HqobSpTnfPJ6C_HYDtkItgjIy-ulHanOonH217m3gof17f5MYQOyWkFSDtT-G5j6?purpose=fullsize)

**GoSail Lab**

**Business model\:** B2B marketing services.

Its customers are AI companies, SaaS startups, and technology brands that need marketing, distribution, and creator partnerships.

[Company website](https://www.gosaillab.com/en)

### What does GoSail Lab actually do?

Its services include\:

- **Influencer marketing\:** Connecting AI brands with relevant creators on X, YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, and Xiaohongshu.
- **Content marketing\:** Developing content strategies and campaigns.
- **Product launches\:** Generating awareness and initial traction for AI products.
- **Creator management\:** Coordinating creators, publishing schedules, and campaign execution.
- **Performance measurement\:** Tracking impressions, engagement, and campaign results.

Interestingly, its website publishes campaign case studies with measurable results.

For example\:

| Campaign | Reported results |
|--------|--------|
| AI product promotion | 2.03M views |
| AI token platform | 726K views |
| AI model platform | 564K views |
| Technical brand campaign | 966K impressions |


These are company-reported figures, not independently audited results. [www.gosaillab.com](https://www.gosaillab.com/en?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.gosaillab.com](https://www.gosaillab.com/en/cases/ai-model-platform-longtail?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.gosaillab.com](https://www.gosaillab.com/en/cases/ai-token-platform-campaign?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.gosaillab.com](https://www.gosaillab.com/en/cases/memory-research-paper-campaign?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## 4\. How the overall business model works

My interpretation of Jason's ecosystem is that it has a fairly interesting growth loop\:

**Jason Zhu's personal brand**

AI content, tutorials, X audience, newsletter

**GoSail Club**

Membership revenue, education, community, creator development

**GoSail Lab**

Brand clients, influencer campaigns, marketing services

**Creator and business network**

Creators gain opportunities; brands gain distribution; members gain connections.

This creates a potential flywheel\:

1. Jason publishes useful AI content and attracts an audience.
2. Some audience members join GoSail Club.
3. The community develops creators and connects people with business opportunities.
4. GoSail Lab works with brands that need creator distribution.
5. Campaigns generate revenue, experience, and further content opportunities.

This is a business-model interpretation rather than a verified breakdown of internal revenue flows.

## 5\. Is Jason Zhu worth paying attention to?

My assessment: **He's an interesting example of an AI engineer transitioning into a creator-led business.**

Three things stand out\:

- **Distribution-first thinking\:** He appears to understand that building a good AI product is only part of the business; getting customers is equally important.
- **Multiple monetization channels\:** Memberships, enterprise training, consulting, and influencer marketing.
- **An interconnected ecosystem\:** His community and agency can potentially reinforce each other.

A few things I'd independently verify before investing in the membership or engaging the agency\:

- Actual member satisfaction and retention.
- Whether the advertised automation tools deliver meaningful value.
- Whether GoSail Lab's campaign metrics translate into qualified leads and paying customers.
- Whether the community's business introductions result in real commercial opportunities.

For additional background, there's also a podcast interview discussing Jason's transition from engineering to entrepreneurship\:

[Podcast: How Jason Zhu turned his online influence into a business](https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/11%E4%B8%AA%E6%9C%88%E6%8E%A8%E7%89%B93%E4%B8%87%E7%B2%89-%E4%B8%80%E4%BA%BA%E5%85%AC%E5%8F%B8%E8%90%A5%E6%94%B660%E4%B8%87-%E4%BB%96%E5%A6%82%E4%BD%95%E6%8A%8A%E5%BD%B1%E5%93%8D%E5%8A%9B%E5%8F%98%E6%88%90%E4%BA%86%E7%94%9F%E6%84%8F-%E5%AF%B9%E8%AF%9Djason/id1719563087?i=1000777280827)\.

---

**Bottom line\:** Jason Zhu is building more than an AI content website. GoSail Club is the community and membership side; GoSail Lab is the commercial AI influencer-marketing agency. Together, they represent a creator-led business ecosystem connecting AI education, community, and brand marketing.
